description: Codex Agents Dashboard on 192.168.0.177:4321. Machine identity comes from the sending computer hostname. Merge these handlers with existing hooks; update the address if the dashboard host changes.

hooks.commandWindows: cmd.exe /d /c "curl.exe --silent --output NUL --connect-timeout 0.25 --max-time 1 --header Content-Type:application/json --header X-Machine:%COMPUTERNAME% --header X-Harness:codex --data-binary @- http://192.168.0.177:4321/api/events & exit /b 0"
